Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 70 - December 2023

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components. 

Mobility Service – Added support for Linux OS for:

  • Azure to Azure – RHEL 8.9, Oracle Linux 8.9, Rocky Linux 8.8, and Rocky Linux 8.9
  • Modernized VMware/Physical to Azure - RHEL 8.9, Oracle Linux 8.9, Rocky Linux 8.8, and Rocky Linux 8.9

This update also provides bug fixes. Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
